name: b2b-research-market-and-account
description: Research skills for B2B teams by Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting, to decide which accounts to target and what is safe to publish: account research, evidence led research assets, claims fact checks and second opinion reviews.

plugins.name: b2b-research-market-and-account
plugins.description: For B2B teams who need facts they can defend: decide which accounts to target, which numbers to publish and whether a draft is safe to send. Get account lists and briefs with verified and unverified fields, research assets with numbers locked to the source, a claims check before anything goes out, and a point by point judgement of another model's critique.
